baseline.equivalence_test: the baseline arm performs exactly one original query retrieval, one frozen QORE K=5 selection, one Answer Scorer pass, and one unchanged Generator call

core_invariants: one initial Wiki-DPR retrieval and one frozen QORE K=5 selection per question
the bridge may issue at most one auxiliary retrieval query and never changes final K=5 context budget
answer hypothesis is formed before generation from reader spans only; no gold, evaluator output, labels, or generated answer is available
the bridge query is used only for retrieval direction; its score never enters QORE or Answer Scorer selection objectives
compact artifacts contain no question, passage, answer hypothesis, bridge query, candidate text, prediction, prompt, or evaluator trace

interfaces.input_schema: question, initial retrieved passages, reader span hypotheses, initial candidate IDs
interfaces.output_schema: optional auxiliary query, deduplicated candidate IDs, consensus support scalars
invariants: distinct-passage support is counted once per passage

plugins.hypothesis: The original query neighborhood is the frozen reference
plugins.output_schema: initial candidate IDs, texts, embeddings, and retrieval scalars

plugins.insertion_point: after initial retrieval and Answer Scorer reader-span diagnostics
plugins.hypothesis: Two distinct initial passages agreeing on a high-probability answer can provide a safe retrieval direction
plugins.input_schema: reader top spans and probabilities per initial passage
plugins.output_schema: optional normalized hypothesis, distinct support count, mean probability

plugins.hypothesis: The hypothesis-augmented query reaches supporting evidence missed by the original query
plugins.output_schema: bridge candidate IDs and retrieval scores
plugins.resource_estimate: one auxiliary query embedding and retrieval on applied questions

plugins.hypothesis: The unchanged Answer Scorer plus QORE K=5 can select from the union without a new objective
plugins.output_schema: five selected candidate IDs and compact selection scalars

plugins.hypothesis: Candidate deduplication and compact privacy are invariant to input ordering
plugins.input_schema: initial and bridge candidate IDs, plugin trace
plugins.output_schema: order agreement, duplicate count, forbidden-field findings

composition.merge_rule: initial candidates precede bridge candidates; duplicate global IDs are retained once; final selection is the unchanged QORE K=5 call

validation.baseline_equivalence: baseline mode never calls the bridge and preserves the frozen Phase 10A retrieval/selection/generation contract

reproducibility.environment: auto-resolved compatible Python; pinned NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct revision 53346005fb0ef11d3b6a83b12c895cca40156b6c; frozen DPR reader

limitations: The mechanism has medium-high collision risk with query expansion and answer-aware retrieval literature; no novelty claim is made.
The screen is report-only and cannot establish L1 utility by itself.
A clean short-screen null is inconclusive under the registered screen policy.
No formal or replication run is authorized by this plan.
